title: Strict Side Panel Tree API
description: Enforce Tab -> Tree -> TreeSection -> TreeItem -> typed control across all side panels; remove TreeDataSection.content and playgroundPanelSection escape hatches; migrate puzzle 2d/5d and CAD play panels.
summary: Enforced strict side-panel tree API: removed TreeDataSection.content escape hatch and playgroundPanelSection/PlaygroundPanelBody; added UiSliderNode/UiNumberStepperNode/UiRingNode/UiIconSelectNode controls; migrated puzzle 2d inspector/settings, puzzle 5d status, and CAD catalog/details panels to declarative UiTreeNode sections; re-exported uiTreeNodeToTreePanelConfig from playground shell entry (fixes CAD runtime import); removed dead CadPlay aside components. Tests: playground renderer 21/21, platform core 13/13, CAD play vite build passes.
